title: Research
seoDescription: Research on race and ethnicity, immigration, consumption, social policy, and computational methods — publications, work in progress, and presentations.
content:
I am a sociologist of inequality working at the intersections of race and ethnicity, immigration, consumption, and social policy. My research asks how inequality is produced and sustained both through material structures — segregation, urban renewal, and policy regimes — and through cultural processes that shape perception, taste, and belonging. Methodologically, I combine computational text analysis, spatial analysis, and qualitative approaches.

My book project, *Race, Space, and Taste in Post-War America*, examines how mid-twentieth-century segregation policies such as redlining and urban renewal shaped urban consumption and the making of White middle-class identity. A parallel strand of my work uses natural language processing to study digital public discourse around migration, health, and inequality, tracing how online platforms foster both polarization and solidarity.

## Research Interests

- Race and Ethnicity
- Immigration
- Consumption
- Social Policy
- Computational Methods

## Methods & Tools

Python, STATA, SPSS, ArcGIS, and ATLAS.ti — supporting natural language processing, spatial analysis, statistical modeling, and qualitative coding.
